newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to ban sharing broker commissions from 1998.
newsitem.headline: France to ban sharing broker commissions from 1998.

text.p: The COB stock market regulator, with the agreement of fund managers, has decided to ban the sharing of broker commissions between fund managers and brokerages from January 1, 1998, a COB official said on Tuesday.
Yves Chartier told a conference that brokers would not be allowed to hand back to fund managers part of the commission they receive for executing orders for the clients of fund managers.
The practice lacked "economic justification" and served to tie the fund manager to the broker, he said.
The Commissions des Operations de Bourse (COB) will also seek to tighten rules on broker research and other services provided to fund managers in the form of "soft commissions."
